lint.message: Moves peak in speed at 50% of their duration: every move eases in and out the same amount. Measured gestures reach peak speed at 38% (they leave fast and arrive slowly); tired/old characters at ~25%; only snappy, energetic ones near 50%. Put a breakdown key early in the move or favour the arrival.

Left Leg moves in a straight line from 1.33 to 1.43 s (bows 4% of its 1.0-stud path). Organic moves curve: measured arm raises bow 22% of their travel, slashes 36%, even punches 6-12%. Add a breakdown key off the straight line (usually higher, or swinging out).

The Left Arm strikes at 51 studs/s but the hips barely move (drop 0.03 studs, shift 0.00 studs). The body must commit: in 10 measured punches the hips drop 3-20 cm (median ~8% of hip height = 0.16 studs here) and travel 16-34 cm toward the target (0.36-0.74 studs); slashes drop the hips 5-8 cm. Key the Root down and forward through the strike.

The Left Arm launches from a dead start: no pull-back, no hip load, no dip in the 0.6 s before it. Real punches don't pull the hand back; they load the hips (pelvis turn peaks ~50 ms before the hand, shoulders ~35 ms before). Slashes raise first for 0.7-1.4 s. Game telegraphs: player light attacks 0.07-0.1 s, heavies 0.17-0.2 s, NPC attacks the player must read >= 0.34 s (Dark Souls 3).
Keys are evenly spaced (every 0.03 s). Action has rhythm: a quick strike between slower anticipation and recovery, holds of different lengths. Re-time the keys so the beats differ.
